Protection | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the maintenance procedures P1 to completely check the proper operation and 
calibration of the relay, this procedures must 
be performed on yearly bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The document is formatted the way to minimize the 
possibility of error causing personal injury or damage to equipment.
The first draft initiated by eng. Rasha Soliman, 
tested by eng Mohamed Rabee, accepted by general director eng. Hamdy Dorgam, 
approved by eng. Mohamed Abou Aiasha head sector of Damanhour power station and 
and
certified by eng. 
Gaber Farahat 
WDEPC Inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required

Work to be carried out
Disconnect the circuit breaker for 
 generator.
Connect test leads between the test set 
 and the current terminal (1&13) for phase (R) in the for the Differential 
 relay.
Increase the injected current slowly until 
 the red indication on the Differential element phase (R) on the relay 
 appears.
Switch off the test set.
Repeat the previous steps for phase (S) but 
 the terminals (2&13)
Repeat the previous steps for phase (T) but 
 the terminals (3&13)
Connect test leads between the test set 
 and the current terminal (4&13) for phase (R) in the for the Differential 
 relay.
Increase the injected current slowly until 
 the red indication on the Differential element phase (R) on the relay 
 appears.
Switch off the test set.
Repeat the previous steps for phase (S) but 
 the terminals (5&13)
Repeat the previous steps for phase (T) but 
 the terminals (6&13)
Return 
relay to service:
If any equipment associated with the relay 
 has been isolated, it should be returned to service by the following 
 restoration steps:
Disconnect the test leads from timer 
 terminal on the relay .
If any equipment associated with the relay 
 has been isolated, it should be returned to service by the following 
 restoration steps:
* 
 Breaker trip coil 
 * Disturbance alarm and fault recorder associated with 
 this relay.
Repeat the circuit breaker of the 
 generator to the normal position.
